blocks.text: Libraries tayyar toolkits hain jo import se istemal hoti hain. Teen standard libraries dikhayi gayi hain: random tasadufi (random) adad ke liye, datetime tareekh aur waqt ke liye, aur statistics mean jaise hisab ke liye.

blocks.title: Python code (har .... ek 4-space indent hai)
blocks.text:
import random
number = random.randint(1, 10)
print("The random number is:", number)

import datetime
print("Current date and time:", datetime.datetime.now())

import statistics
data = [23, 45, 67, 89, 12, 44, 56]
print("The mean value is:", statistics.mean(data))

random games, simulations ya qurandazi ka jeetne wala chunne mein madad deti hai; datetime waqiat darj karne aur yaad-dihani mein; statistics mean, median aur mode nikalti hai. Sirf zaroori cheez import karein; mazeed libraries https://docs.python.org/3/ par hain (Did You Know).

blocks.prompt: Misal ki data list ka mean kya hai?
Class activity: random se 1 se 50 tak 10 adad ki list banayein aur statistics se un ka mean print karein.
blocks.explanation: import random, statistics; nums = [random.randint(1, 50) for _ in range(10)]; print(statistics.mean(nums)). Mean har baar badalta hai kyunke adad tasadufi hain.

items: Library istemal ke liye import karein: random.randint, datetime.datetime.now, statistics.mean (data ka mean 48).
